description_en: Call this operation to publish the Thing Model of a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口发布指定产品的物模型
name: PublishThingModel

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page of the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must pass the ID value. Otherwise, the call will fail.
If the Instance Overview page or the ID value is not available, you do not need to pass this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group.

<notice>IoT Platform only supports resource group management at the instance level. The ResourceGroupId request parameter is no longer valid and does not need to be passed.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。

<notice>目前，物联网平台仅支持实例维度的资源组管理。请求参数ResourceGroupId配置已无效，无需再传入。
</notice>
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product.
You can view it on the product page of the IoT Platform console, or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation to obtain the ProductKey value
parameters.help_zh:
产品的ProductKey。
可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看，或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看ProductKey的取值
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The version number of the Thing Model.
The version number supports uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and periods (.). The length must not exceed 16 characters
parameters.help_zh:
设置物模型的版本号。
版本号支持英文大、小字母、数字和英文句号（.），长度范围不超过16个字符
parameters.name: model_version

parameters.help_en: The description of the Thing Model version
parameters.name: description

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
